caption: The drawing consists of a single black symbol centered on an off-white or slightly yellowed paper background. The symbol is composed of several geometric elements: at the top, there is a horizontal thick black line with short vertical lines at each end, resembling a capital "T" with blocked terminals. Extending downward from the center of this horizontal line is a vertical thick black line that curves into a semicircular shape, ending with a small upward curve at its lower point. The semicircular line forms almost three-quarters of a circle, opening toward the left, and the overall design is created with consistent line thickness. The background is empty except for the main symbol, and there are faint discolorations or marks near the edges of the paper.
title: Cattle Brand
